subject: Request: phased billing relief for pilot due to model-v2 rollout timing
messages:
From: Eli Kim <eli.kim@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot ask — billing relief while model-v2 runway slips

Jordan —

Quick context: we're mid-pilot with a subset of clinicians and are seeing higher-than-expected token consumption because we can't use the targeted model-v2 routing you promised for March. The fallback routing increases calls and costs by ~2.3x on our test cohort (summary attached). The launch window for our clinical pilot is tight; without rate relief we risk pausing the pilot and pushing the launch by several quarters.

Can Redwood provide a temporary accommodation (credits or a phased discount tied to the v2 rollout date)? Ideally: a timeboxed discount for the first one or two months post-v2 or a credit to offset overage while we stay on fallback. We'll sign an MOU that ties the accommodation to Redwood's roadmap commitment.

Attachments: pilot-usage-report.csv, MOU-draft.pdf

Appreciate a quick read — Eli
Eli Kim
Head of Integrations, Clearpath Health
eli.kim@clearpathhealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Eli Kim <eli.kim@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — billing relief while model-v2 runway slips

Thanks Eli — I read the report and the ask is reasonable given the gap. I'm escalating to product and finance to scope an internal approval path.

Quick proposal from my side to keep the pilot moving (subject to approvals):
- 30% credits applied to incremental overage in month 1 after v2 is enabled
- 15% reduction for months 2-3 (phased step-down)
- Clearpath signs the attached MOU tying the accommodation to an explicit v2 ETA and a go/no-go checklist (observability + fallback acceptance)

Karthik / Monica — can you weigh in on feasibility and the ETA to unblock the v2 routing? Laura — can you advise whether finance can pre-authorize a discretionary accommodation pending exec sign-off?

I'll keep you posted.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
Office: (650) 555-0132

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Eli Kim <eli.kim@clearpathhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — billing relief while model-v2 runway slips

Jordan / Eli —

Thanks for the context and the MOU draft. Technical note: the specific blocker you mention (model-v2 multi-model intelligent routing for short-context inference) is on the roadmap and the current ETA for an alpha drop is 2028-03-25. That said, there are two practical options for clearing some of the overhead sooner:
1) Light-weight routing flag (canary) that reduces cross-model thrash but won't be as cost-efficient as full v2 — ~3 week turnaround if we prioritize
2) Provide a client-side batching suggestion and a prefetch KV guidance that the customer can adopt immediately (low SW changes on their side)

From product's POV, any commercial accommodation needs:
- a documented acceptance criterion (what "v2 enabled" means),
- a short MOU that ties credits to the ETA + a rollback clause if v2 slips beyond a second threshold, and
- confirmation the customer will adopt the recommended fallback to limit abuse.

If Jordan sends the expected incremental spend numbers, I can commit to the 03/25 cadence or accelerate option (1) if this becomes a top priority.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior PM, Inference Platform

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Mar 2028 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — billing relief while model-v2 runway slips

Jordan —

Finance can support a limited, timeboxed accommodation but we need:
1) a deal id (please confirm CLP-2028-031),
2) a forecast of the monthly overage amount (dollars) for month 0 and month 1 post-v2, and
3) legal signoff on the MOU.

I can pre-authorize up to $15,000 in discretionary credits while we route to Marcus for exec approval. Anything above that needs explicit exec sign-off with a recorded rationale. Also need to ensure credits are ledgered and marked as one-off (no change to list price).

Jordan — can you provide numbers and copy the forecast spreadsheet (cost-projection.xlsx) with a 'with accommodation' and 'without accommodation' column?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Mar 2028 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — billing relief while model-v2 runway slips

Appreciate the clear thread. I'm comfortable approving a constrained executive accommodation given the customer relationship and the roadmap dependency. Conditions:
- One-time credit capped at the greater of $15,000 or 25% of the customer's forecasted first-month incremental overage (whichever is higher),
- Clearpath must sign the MOU binding the accommodation to v2's ETA and the rollback clause,
- Product must confirm the v2 alpha readiness milestone (target 2028-03-25) and provide a short remediation plan if that slips beyond one additional month,
- CS (Monica) will monitor usage and confirm adoption of the recommended temporary mitigations.

Laura — please put the credit on the books as a one-off contra entry and confirm how this will appear on their March invoice.

Jordan — get me the signed MOU + the final cost projection and I'll finalize.

Marcus Lin
VP, Commercial Operations

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Eli Kim <eli.kim@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Mar 2028 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — billing relief while model-v2 runway slips

Eli — thank you for the patience. Quick update and next steps: we have exec-level provisional approval with conditions (see thread). In short: Redwood will provide a timeboxed one-off accommodation per Marcus's note (cap = greater of $15k or 25% of month-1 overage) contingent on: signed MOU, product confirming v2 alpha readiness target (2028-03-25) or a prioritized acceleration plan, and CS monitoring the mitigation adoption.

I've attached an updated MOU and the cost projection you asked for (cost-projection.xlsx). Please review, sign via the DocuSign link below, and we'll apply the ledgered credit once legal and finance complete the intake.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/rooms/abcd-1234
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/HS-56421

Next actions for Clearpath:
- Sign the attached MOU by 2028-03-12,
- Confirm acceptance of the temporary fallback guidance (outlined in the MOU),
- We will mark and apply the one-off credit on your March invoice once paperwork is complete.

Thanks again — I'll coordinate the billing application and loop legal if anything needs redlines.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
